entries.name: Theopolis Institute
entries.subject: Bible, liturgy and culture
points_to_weigh: Led by Peter Leithart, whose views are associated with the Federal Vision. His PCA presbytery acquitted him of heresy charges in 2011, and he later joined the CREC (Wikipedia).

Federal Vision teaching was formally criticized by the OPC (2006 report), the PCA (2007 study committee) and other Reformed bodies (Wikipedia). Readers seeking PCA- or OPC-aligned teaching should weigh this.
entries.description: Institute offering intensive and online courses, essays and podcasts.
